<noinclude><pagequality level="1" user="" /></noinclude><section begin=par134 />{{GHGmargin-letter|134|m}}
Such cases as {{GHGheb|text=שִׁבְעַת הַיָּמִים}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ju|chapter=14|verse=17}} (which is determined by a following determinate genitive) are explained from {{GHGpar|127|b}}; {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 Ch|chapter=9|verse=25}} perhaps from {{GHGpar|126|q}}; in {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=30|verse=26}} probably the light of all the seven days of the week is meant; on the other hand, in {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 S|chapter=9|verse=20}} and 25:38 the article is, with Wellhausen, to be omitted.

{{GHGmargin-letter|134|n}}
3. Certain specifications of ''measure, weight'', or ''time'', are commonly omitted after numerals, e.g. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=20|verse=16}} {{GHGheb|text=אֶ֫לֶף כֶּ֫סֶף|translate=a thousand}} (shekels) ''of silver''; so also before {{GHGheb|text=זָהָב}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=24|verse=22}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 K|chapter=10|verse=16}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=7|verse=23}}, cf. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=119|verse=72}}. Moreover, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ru|chapter=3|verse=15}} {{GHGheb|text=שֵׁשׁ שְׂעֹרִים|translate=six}} (ephahs) ''of barley''; {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 S|chapter=10|verse=4}} {{GHGheb|text=שְׁתֵּי־לֶ֫חֶם|translate=two}} (sc. ''loaves'', see verse 3) ''of bread'', cf. 17:17 {{GHGheb|text=עֲשָׂרָה לֶ֫חֶם}}; {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 S|chapter=16|verse=1}}, where before {{GHGheb|text=קַ֫יִץ}} a measure, or perhaps some term like ''cakes'', is to be supplied.—The number of cubits is stated in the Priestly Code ({{GHGbible-ref|book=Ex|chapter=26|verse=2}}, &c.) and in 1 K 6 and 7 (otherwise only in {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ez|chapter=40|verse=5}}, 21, 47:3. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Zc|chapter=5|verse=2}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 Ch|chapter=11|verse=23}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 Ch|chapter=4|verse=2}} f.) by the addition of {{GHGheb|text=בָּֽאַמָּה}} prop. ''by the cubit''. Also in {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ex|chapter=27|verse=11}} the Samaritan and LXX read {{GHGheb|text=בָּֽאַמָּה}} after {{GHGheb|text=אֹרֶךְ}}, and in 27:15 {{GHGheb|text=אַמָּה}} after {{GHGheb|text=עֶשְׂרֵה}}.

{{GHGmargin-letter|134|o}}
'''4.''' The ''ordinals'' above 10 have no special forms, but are expressed by the corresponding cardinals, which may then stand either before or after the object numbered, e.g. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=7|verse=11}} {{GHGheb|text=בְּשִׁבעָה עָשָׂר יוֹם|translate=on the seventeenth day}}; {{GHGbible-ref|book=Dt|chapter=1|verse=3}} {{GHGheb|text=בְּאַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה|translate=in the fortieth year}}; cf. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=14|verse=5}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 K|chapter=25|verse=27}}, and, with repetition of {{GHGheb|text=שָׁנָה}} in a compound number, {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 K|chapter=6|verse=1}}; such a cardinal occurs without {{GHGheb|text=בְּ}} (and therefore in the ''accus. temporis'', according to {{GHGpar|118|k}}) in {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=14|verse=4}} (the Samaritan, however, has {{GHGheb|text=ובשלש}}); with the article (but without a numbered object, see under k), {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 K|chapter=19|verse=19}}.<ref>Somewhat different from this is {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ex|chapter=19|verse=15}} ''be ready'' {{GHGheb|text=לִשְׁל֫שֶׁת יָמִים}} prop. ''after three days'', i.e. ''on the third day'' (in verses 11 and 16 and in {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ezr|chapter=10|verse=8}} the ordinal is used), also {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 S|chapter=30|verse=13}} {{GHGheb|text=כִּי חָלִיתִי הַיּוֹם שְׁלשָׁה|translate=because three days agone I fell sick}}, prop. ''to-day three'' (days).</ref>—On the position of the numeral as a genitive following its noun, cf. e.g. {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 K|chapter=16|verse=10}} {{GHGheb|text=בִּשְׁנַת עֶשְׂרִים וָשֶׁבַע|translate=in the twenty and seventh year}}, and with a determinate numeral, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ex|chapter=12|verse=18}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Nu|chapter=33|verse=38}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Dt|chapter=15|verse=9}}. In this case, however, {{GHGheb|text=שָׁנָה}} is very frequently repeated, e.g. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=7|verse=11}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 K|chapter=13|verse=10}}; after a determinate numeral, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Lv|chapter=25|verse=10}}.<ref>All these expressions may indeed be explained by supposing that, e.g. in {{GHGbible-ref|book=Lv|chapter=25|verse=10}}, the proper meaning is ''the year of the fifty years'' which it completed, i.e. the fiftieth year; but it is more correct to regard {{GHGheb|text=שְׁנַת}} or {{GHGheb|text=בִּשְׁנַת}} in such cases not as a real {{GHGterm|nomen regens}}, but simply as a connective form to be explained on the analogy of the cases mentioned in {{GHGpar|128|k}}.</ref>

{{GHGmargin-letter|134|p}}
Rem. In numbering days of the month and years, the cardinals are very frequently used instead of the ordinals even for the numbers from 1 to 10, e.g. {{GHGheb|text=בִּשְׁנַת שְׁתַּיִם}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 K|chapter=15|verse=25}}; {{GHGheb|text=בִּשְׁנַת שָׁלשׁ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 K|chapter=18|verse=1}}, &c., cf. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Dt|chapter=15|verse=9}}. The months themselves are always numbered by the ordinals ({{GHGheb|text=בָּרִאשׁוֹן}}, {{GHGheb|text=בַּשֵּׁנִי}}, &c., up to {{GHGheb|text=בָּֽעֲשִׂירִי}}), but not the days of the month, e.g. {{GHGheb|text=בְּאֶחָד לַחֹ֫דֶשׁ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=8|verse=5}}, &c., {{GHGheb|text=בְּאַרְבָּעָה לַחֹ֫דֶשׁ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Zc|chapter=7|verse=1}}; {{GHGheb|text=בַּֽחֲמִשָּׁה לַחֹ֫דֶשׁ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ez|chapter=1|verse=1}}, &c., {{GHGheb|text=בְּשִׁבְעָה לַחֹ֫דֶשׁ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 K|chapter=25|verse=8}}, {{GHGheb|text=בְּתִשְׁעָה לַחֹ֫דֶשׁ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Lv|chapter=23|verse=32}} (always, however, {{GHGheb|text=בֶּֽעָשׂר לַחֹ֫דֶשׁ|translate=on the tenth day of the month}}).
